text:
The equation for the decomposition of hydrogen peroxide is shown.
2H2O2→  2H2O  +  O2
The reaction is exothermic.
When a small amount of a catalyst is added, the oxygen is produced more quickly.
Which statement about the catalyst is correct?
A
The catalyst makes the reaction more exothermic.
B
The mass of catalyst is the same before and after the reaction.
C
The catalyst increases the final volume of oxygen produced.
D
All of the catalyst is used up in the reaction.

options.label: A
options.text: The catalyst makes the reaction more exothermic.

options.label: B
options.text: The mass of catalyst is the same before and after the reaction.

options.label: C
options.text: The catalyst increases the final volume of oxygen produced.

options.label: D
options.text: All of the catalyst is used up in the reaction.
